companies.name: ワイルド・ウェル・コントロール

relations.text: 制御不能な海底坑井事故に備えた計画づくりと対応を、ワイルド・ウェル・コントロールに委託している
relations.text_en: APA contracted Wild Well Control for contingency planning and response to uncontrolled subsea well events

source.label: APA Corp 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Additionally, the Company has contracted with Wild Well Control Company for contingency planning for and response to uncontrolled subsea well events and other drilling activities.

companies.name: エジプト一般石油公社

relations.text: 2025年は、エジプトのEGPCへの販売が、全世界の原油・天然ガス・NGL収入の約15%を占めた
relations.text_en: Sales to EGPC in Egypt were about 15 percent of worldwide crude oil, natural gas and NGL revenues in 2025

source.label: APA Corp 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: During 2025, sales to EGPC in Egypt accounted for approximately 15 percent of the Company’s worldwide crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs revenues.

companies.name: シノペック・インターナショナル

relations.text: エジプトの石油・ガス事業に、合弁会社を通じて3分の1の少数持分を持っている
relations.text_en: Through a joint venture, Sinopec holds a one-third minority participation interest in APA's Egypt oil and gas operations

source.label: APA Corp 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Through the joint venture, Sinopec holds a one-third minority participation interest in the Company’s oil and gas operations in Egypt.

companies.name_en: Sinopec International Petroleum Exploration and Production Corporation

relations.text: スリナムのブロック58で、探鉱の50%を持つ事業者であるトタルエナジーズと合弁契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: APA has a joint venture agreement with TotalEnergies, which holds a 50 percent working interest and operates Block 58

source.label: APA Corp 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: TotalEnergies holds a 50 percent working interest in exploration activities in Block 58 as the operator.
